derivation:
simpa [dir, norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv] using
  (norm_iteratedFDeriv_clm_apply_const ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.1 hV).2.contDiffAt) (x := p) (n := j) (by exact_mod_cast le_top))
explanation: Mathlib bounds the iterated derivative of y ↦ (f y) c by ‖c‖ times the iterated derivative of f. Instantiate f with fderiv ℝ V and c with w; the derivative-continuity hypothesis follows from hV, and norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv converts the right-hand side to the (j + 1)-st derivative of V. The current proof establishes the bound directly rather than applying this declaration.
